finding.message:
Insecure hashing algorithm (SHA256) depends on [password (balanceCredential)](1).
Insecure hashing algorithm (SHA256) depends on [password (goCredential)](2).

findings.rationale: The SHA256 value distinguishes workspace/session combinations for ephemeral UsageRefreshService cache equality. ProviderUsageResult is not Codable; this digest is neither persisted nor used as a password verifier. Actual dashboard credentials remain in SecretStore. Re-review every consumer if this digest is persisted, exposed, or used for authentication.

finding.message: This operation stores 'call to sorted()' in the user defaults database. It may contain unencrypted sensitive data from [.collapsedDashboardAccountIDs](1).

findings.rationale: The preference stores the collapsed state of configured local IDs, not credentials or provider account identifiers. ProviderAccountConfiguration uses a provider name or provider plus random UUID, and the collapse updater rejects unknown IDs. The configuration already persists those IDs; secrets are stored separately through SecretStore. Re-review if account-ID generation or callers accept sensitive identifiers.

finding.message: This operation stores 'accountID' in the user defaults database. It may contain unencrypted sensitive data from [accountID](1).

findings.rationale: freeActiveAccountID stores the configured local account ID chosen as the CodexBar Free active account. IDs are the provider name or provider plus a random UUID, already persisted with the configuration; chooseActiveAccount accepts only an existing candidate ID, and secrets are stored separately through SecretStore. Re-review if account-ID generation or callers accept sensitive identifiers.

finding.message: This operation stores 'secret' in the user defaults database. It may contain unencrypted sensitive data from [secret](1).

findings.rationale: UITestSecretStore is compiled only in DEBUG builds and activates only on simulators with a UUID-isolated defaults suite; Release builds do not contain it. It accepts ui-test-credential, the cursor-plan- prefixed plan-parity values, and exact parsed synthetic coding, Codex (personal, work and plan-tier), Cursor billing/session, Greptile, Grok, OpenCode console, Claude profile and matching-cookie subscription-billing fixtures. Other values are rejected before the preferences write. These synthetic values grant no provider access, and provider networking stays blocked except the existing synthetic Greptile host. Re-review any accepted value, caller, activation guard or network boundary change.
